[Trend Position]
· Current price ($79,511.91) vs SMA5 ($81,770.19)/SMA20 ($82,480.06)/SMA50 ($81,775.14): trading below short-to-mid term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($75,275.7)/SMA200 ($72,894.45): trading above long-term trends, confirming a strong support base.
· 52-week position (37.2%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.1→40.2): entering oversold territory, suggesting potential for a bounce.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-402.7510→-369.4703): improving, maintaining a bearish convergence phase.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $79,559.65) + band width reduced to 7.08%, indicating decreased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($78,248.91): based on Pivot S1 ($76,794.06), potential for further decline if broken.
· Swing resistance ($81,346.95): resistance from SMA5/20/50, a break above would signal a trend reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low / Lower High continuation): weak pattern persists, confirming a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.83x): subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying on confirmation of RSI exiting oversold and trading above SMA200.
